evidence.note: Large dark serif title and blue eyebrow on plain white; no texture or grain.
Heavily blurred prior diagram as a soft backdrop; no text in it is meant to be read, and it has no crisp hairlines.
Three white rounded cards with soft drop shadows; serif card headings and mid-grey bullet text at generous size with good contrast.
Source links and attributions are the smallest text (about 13px), mid-grey and underlined, still legible.
Header progress rule is a few px solid blue, not a hairline grid.

rationale: The slide uses big soft shapes (rounded shadowed cards, a blurred backdrop) and paper feel from colour only, with no texture, grain or 1px grid lines. Body and heading type is generous and well contrasted at both sizes; even the smallest source lines stay readable. This matches the pass descriptor.
